QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_28

question.text: A 'Social Impact Assessment Organisation' under SEBI ICDR must satisfy either of the following:

answer.text: Have minimum Rs 50 lakh paid-up capital AND 10 years of audit experience.
Be a Section 8 company AND have at least one Big-4 firm as minority shareholder.

Employ Social Impact Assessors with a track record of minimum 3 years in conducting social impact assessment; OR employ at least two full-time Social Impact Assessors each with minimum 3 years' experience who shall sign the social impact assessment report.
Have 100% foreign ownership with FEMA compliance and an RBI no-objection certificate.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 2.2.3, a Social Impact Assessment Organisation must either (i) employ Social Impact Assessors and have a track record of minimum 3 years conducting social impact assessment; OR (ii) employ at least two full-time SIAs each with minimum 3 years' experience who shall sign the social impact assessment report. These are SEBI ICDR 2018 criteria. **The Trap:** Option A invents a capital requirement. Option B invents a structural constraint. Option D invents an FDI rule. **Cross-Exam Context:** XV (RA) treats RA-Organisation criteria — similar 'two qualified full-timers' architecture. V-A (MF Distributor) for corporate distributor eligibility — analogous. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** When forming your own SIA-Organisation, two full-time SIAs with 3+ years each is the lowest-friction path — document the two signatories' experience letters and engagement histories to satisfy the '3 years in conducting social impact assessment' test at organisation registration.
